newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London static, eye on China.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London static, eye on China.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London were little changed to slightly lower from the Hong Kong closing levels as many players awaited more news out of China following the death of the Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
"It has been very quiet with most shares trading at their Hong Kong close. We've seen a bit of selling which could mean we'll have consolidation in Hong Kong tomorrow," one market maker said.

In Hong Kong on Thursday, the blue-chip Hang Seng Index closed 305.11 points or 2.33 percent higher at 13,411.33 as Deng's death was seen as removing uncertainty hanging over the market during recent sessions.
"Today's rally in Hong Kong caught a lot of bears by surprise. But tomorrow, is another day and people may be a bit more cautious as they wait for further news out of China," another dealer said.
